title: Changing a box
instructions: The = sign is not 'equals' like in math. It means 'gets a copy of'.
Read it right to left: score = score + 5; works out score + 5, then puts the answer back into score.
So the box on the left changes, and the right side is where the value comes from.
task: Add one line so score goes from 10 to 15. The program should print:  Score: 15
hint:
Work it out on the right, store it on the left:

    score = score + 5;
